Officer's narrative
On the afternoon in question, Driver 1 was completing a left turn at a Pearland, Texas intersection when the front of
Driver 2's vehicle made contact with the rear quarter pnael of Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front
passenger seat and was present in the vehicle at the time of the impact, as confirmed by both drivers and by the
witnesses on scene. Driver 2 gave a statement that matched Driver 1's account of how the collision occurred. Two
witnesses and the scene photographs are consistent with that sequence. The visible damage to the rear quarter
panel and bumper corresponds to the impact described, and no earlier damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to
any party. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and described significant pain. The impact appeared light, and the
severity of the reported injury does not fit the force observed at the scene. Driver 1 is named on the auto policy
covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene.
